definitions.explanation: The school subject that teaches cooking, sewing, nutrition, and managing a household. In Japan it is taught to all students, boys and girls alike, in elementary and secondary school.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家庭科|かていか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: home economics class
- {家庭科|かていか}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧: home economics room
- ⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧⟦{実習|じっしゅう}→実習：03077_jisshuu⟧: cooking practical (a typical lesson)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Until the 1990s, secondary-school home economics was required only for girls; it has been taught to both sexes since 1993 (junior high) and 1994 (high school).
